title: Construir oracle independiente para presión del frontier
mission: Build an implementation-independent fixture/oracle suite for frontier-pressure decisions so the live compiler can be checked against known expected outcomes without sharing its implementation logic. Cover launch pressure, dedupe, terminal work, live owners and stale recovery boundaries.
definition_of_done: A compact fixture corpus represents concurrent recent beacons, duplicate worker identity, terminal returns, a live pin/heartbeat, a >=10m silent owner, duplicate dedupe keys and unclaimed useful work.
Expected outputs explicitly encode distinct_recent_launches, target_claimable=clamp(8,ceil(1.5*N),40), effective live owners, claimable useful work and FRONTIER_THIN/REPLACEABLE_PRESSURE decisions.
The oracle does not import or duplicate production compiler decision code; expected values are independently specified.
A runnable test adapter can compare compiler output to the oracle fixtures and fail on liveness, terminal or dedupe mistakes.
No result from this verification lane promotes production /w or Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
